Enjoy the Experience!FAQsWhat age group is this performing arts camp designed for?The camp is specifically designed for children aged 5 to 14, offering age-appropriate activities and instruction.What types of performing arts activities are included in the workshops?Campers participate in a variety of engaging activities, including acting, dance, singing, and speech workshops to develop a wide range of skills.What should campers bring with them each day?Campers are required to bring their own non-perishable snacks and lunch every day to ensure they stay energized throughout the workshops.Who are the instructors leading the performing arts workshops?All camp teachers either possess or are working towards a degree in their arts discipline and have successfully passed thorough background checks, ensuring professional and safe instruction.Will campers have the opportunity to perform?Yes, at the end of the session, campers proudly put on a free show, inviting friends and family to cheer on their artistic accomplishments.How do customers redeem their purchase for the performing arts workshop?After purchasing the deal, customers must visit the merchant's website directly to complete the redemption process and finalize their registration.
